book.name: Mak
book.title: MAK Kamambuno wakai Mak muno boglkwa

content: Spirit kinde yagl ta bogl moglko Yesus simenda endungwa
Yesus yene disaipelma wagle bogl ende Galili Niglmong koglo imbo Gerasa yomba dumonomugl eingwa.
Ana Yesus bot mina ende menda ongo, yagl ta spirit kinde bogl moglkwa, ye kombuglo dra yomba geglko pandiglmara ende menda ungo, igle Yesus bogl tengigl yembrika.
Kombuglo dra yomba geglko pandiglmara suna igle, yagl i pai wu ikine ikine ongwa, ana yomba suwarata ye ake kane sinambuka mere manga, ama sen koraglkwa kuno erekrukwa.
Sraglpre enge mere ye ongo ya kagle kane singwa. Ba engenge ye sen simbiglki dindre ana ye kagle pagl ain si erekrukwa. Yomba suwarata yombuglomo kuno eran ye ake gidinambuka mere manga.
Etne ya enduwer ye kombuglo dra yomba geglko pandiglmara suna i mogl ana meglmbe giglte suna igle ye kina gundo kaglkane ere, ana kombuglo indre yene nangiye simbiglki dungwa.
Ye tau eglke dagl mogl Yesus kandre, ye mukundi pi yange Yesus guma mina goglko bonduglkwa.
Ana kaglkane pond kaima yungwa, “Yesus, God mitna imbo kaima Wam! Ene na sragl ere naratne? God kangiye mina na yana diga, ene na giu ere narekro!”
Ye ka dungwa i sraglpre, okuna Yesus yegl ditongwa, “Ene spirit kinde, yagl i mina ende menda wo!”
Ana Yesus krapogl ye tongwa, “Ene kangin irane?” Ye di ikine endungwa, “Na kangina Ami, sraglpre no merkinde kaima mounga!”
Ana ye yana aglke aglke di Yesus tongwa, “Makan igle spirit kinde dimenda endekro.”
Bugla merkinde makaisi meglmbe giglte mangigl ta akete mogl kaiya ne meglkwa.
Spirit yanadi Yesus teingwa, “No di bugla meglmara iro ende ana kan winge etn no ende bugla deno munduno mina suna enamga.”

Yesus ye yegl eriyo ditongo ana spirit kinde wagle ende menda undre ana ende bugla deno munduno mina suna eingwa. Ana bugla merkinde kaima kerikwa 2,000 orkwa, dangine pigle moglmara kopap ende atne pi yange niglmong mina suna pi, ana nigl ne geglkwa.
Bugla sugl yomba ye mukundi endpi ana taragl orkwa i taun ya yungu epigl meglmara i pra boglo kugl diteingo ana yomba sragl mere plau dungwa i kanamnedi pre ende menda eingwa.

Yomba ende Yesus moglmara undre ye kanigwa yagl ta okuna spirit kinde merkinde ye mina suna meglkwa. Ye nomanemo wu du-wakai pango, kungugl gagl endindre igle amedi moglko ana ye prapra kan kundugl geglkwa.
Yomba tau yagl ta spirit kinde bogl akiye moglko, Yesus taragl okuna orko plau dungo kanigwa i yomba ditendre ana bugla mina plau dungwa i ama akiye diteingwa.
Ana yeglpre yomba mambuno bogl Yesus ka-tange tendre ye makano mina igle moglkre kondo endpo dingwa.
Yesus ende bot mina suna ongo ana yagl ta okuna spirit kinde suna moglkwa ikra Yesus omara akiye enambugle dungwa.
Yesus ye unambedi pirkrukwa, ba dungwa, “Ene ende yungunomugl pindre ana Yaglkande ene mitn gogltre ana taragl pond ene ere tongwa i yombanma meglmara dito.”
Yegl dungo yagle i ende dumo kande Dikapolis we dimara pi ana mambuno bogl, Yesus taragl ye mina ere tongwa ikra ditongwa. Ana yomba prapra pir sipuglo dingwa.
Ambai gak ta goglko ana ambu ta kinde sungwa
Yesus kordagl bot mina ende ikine niglmong koglo imbo pi niglmong bina moglko, yomba merkinde ye moglmara makaisi mogl winambo dingwa.
Ana Jairus, ye makai yungu yagl kande, ye igle wu Yesus kandre, yene yange Yesus kagle mina sindre
ana ye nomanemo bogl akiye kamange pond ere tongwa, “Na ambura kembra goragledi orkwa. Ene kaima undre ana ongun ambai kembra mina tembe yemin kade ye kindemo dundinan ana wakai morambuka.”
Ana Yesus ye bogl akiye ende embrika. Yomba merkinde kaima omara pi ana mogl winambodi kitne kitne erikwa.
Ana ambu ta igle moglkwa, ye nangiye mina bormai wu pango buglayungu 12 orkwa.
Ambumo dokta merkinde kango geu pond ere teingwa, te ye monimo prapra marasin mina ende kondungwa. Ba ye kindemo argan eragla paiyondi, kondo ere wu kandekinde kaima ongwa.
Ambumo i okuna Yesus kamo boglo prukwa. Yeglpre yomba merkinde meglmara pukamugl ye Yesus mokomugl undre ana gaglmo suna olto akungwa.
Sraglpre, yene yegl di prukwa, “Na ye gaglmo keunde akimbo na kindena argan erambuka.”
Ye eremogl Yesus gaglmo olto akungo ana oglandi bormaimo siget-dungwa. Ana yene nangiye sunakra prukwa ye kindemo bu yongwa.
Oglandi Yesus prukwa ye mina yombuglomo ende menda ongwa. Ana ye yomba merkinde meglmara suna kan aketendre, ana krapoglkwa, “Ira na gatna suna akume?”
Yene disaipelma wagle di ikine endingwa, “Ene kano, yomba merkinde mogl ene sidakaglkwa. Ene kan yei pandigl krapogl, ‘Ira na akume dinga?’”
Ba Yesus ira akungwa i kanagledi aimande toro kan winambo dungwa.
Ana ambu ikra prukwa taragl ye mina plaudi tongwa, ye undre ana yange Yesus kagle mina sindre, kundugl gogl noko purdungo, ana taragl ormere mundu kaima boglo kugl Yesus tongwa.
Yesus ambumo i ditongwa, “Na ambura, ene pirnginen orko kinden argan orkwa. Noman pokndi yenan endpo, ana kinden ikra argan orkwa.”
Yesus ka i di moglko, Jairus makai yungu sugl yomba yungumugl yomba tau meglkwa undre, dingwa, “Ene ambutn goglkwa. Sraglpre ene ka denbi wakane ka beke tongwa yomba bogl di motne?”
Ye ka dingwa i Yesus pirwinge ere ana ka yegl di makai yungu sugl moglkwa yagle tongwa, “Ene kundugl goglkro, ene pirngi keunde do.”
Ana yomba prapra ta dungo ye omara akiye pikrikwa, Pita ya Jems te angigle Jon bogl eingwa.
Ana Jairus makai yungu sugl moglkwa yagle yungumugl ye wingo, Yesus kangwa, yomba kai kaglkane pond ere terebare yei meglkwa.
Yesus ende yungugl pindre ana yomba ditongwa, “Sraglpre ene prapra miriye gogl nomano kinde orko, kai kaglkane erim? Ambai gak i ta goglkrukwa, ba ye ugl keunde pangwa.”

Ba yomba ye bakagl gaugl ere teingwa. Yeglpre ye prapra dimenda ende ana ye ambai gakmo nem mam ya, yene disaipelma suwota akiye eingwa ikra bogl ye ende yungugl kiule ambai gak pai moglmara igle eingwa.
Yesus ambai gak ongo akindre ana ditongwa, “Talitha, koum!” (Ka i mambuno yegl, “Ambai kembra, na ene diteinga, andiglo!”)
Ana ambai gak oglandi andigl ana mambuno bogl konbo wu ikine ikine ongwa (ambaimo i buglayungu 12 nongwa). I plau dungwa enge ye prapra sipuglo dingwa.
Ba Yesus ka giglendi di ye tendre, dungwa, “Ene yomba suwarata ka i ditembi pir dinaglmiwo, ambai taragl ninambuka pre ta i teiyo.”
